name: srvname-full-permit-valid
description: RFC 4985 §4: a permittedSubtrees SRVName constraint expressed as a full _Service.Name (_mail.example.com) is satisfied by an SRVName SAN of _mail.example.com. The constraint is encoded as the IA5String _mail.example.com inside an otherName whose OID is id-on-dnsSRV (1.3.6.1.5.5.7.8.7); the SAN uses the same form.
notes: Most validators do not implement RFC 4985 name-constraint matching. With the NC marked critical and the SRVName form present in the SAN, RFC 5280 §4.2.1.10 requires such validators to either process the constraint or reject the chain - so divergence is expected to be the norm, not the exception.
